name: Silicon Labs CP210x USB-UART bridge
summary: USB-serial chip used on many ESP32 dev boards, GPS modules and drones.

linux.notes: The cp210x driver is built into Linux.

darwin.notes: If no /dev/cu.SLAB_USBtoUART or /dev/cu.usbserial port appears, install the Silicon Labs VCP driver.

win32.notes: Windows Update normally installs the driver; Silicon Labs also publishes it.
